notes: plan_migration is a Dijkstra search over (schema, field-state) with ties broken by the lexicographically smallest edge-id list; plans may revisit schemas (M rules).
execute_plan applies corrections on first arrival at their pinned schema, checks every edge prerequisite and reports E_PREREQ_FAILED with the failed edge (C rules, M11).
FieldView keeps explicit nulls as the null state; null presence and fill mode follow the field policy before the null_semantics defaults (N rules).
pipeline: exact null-token matching, processing order by received_seq then line, canonical replay identity, holder set at the partner stage, receipt check per record batch (K13, K16).
